note: _ego vadam absque liberis_ – I will remain childless; I must go the way of childless men (Knox). The meaning “to be, to stay” for _vadere_ echoes Hebrew usage. Here are some problematic translations that suggest an emphasis on dying in childlessness: I shall go without children (Douay Version), ich gehe kinderlos dahin (Arndt), moi, je m’en irai sans enfants (Glaire).
